name: ShopWave Marketplace
tagline: An online marketplace — category tree, orders, line items, discounts and reviews.
description: Six months of orders. Categories form a two-level tree via parent_id. An order has one or more order_items (unit_price is the list price at purchase; discount is a fraction 0–0.2, so line revenue = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)). order_total already includes discounts.
